event_summary: Low white-gray fog and cloud patches move and thin over a mountainous valley, revealing green fields and a village.
raw_event_description: At the start, most of the valley is covered by pale fog, with only faint hills visible. As the video progresses, fog patches shift across the frame and become thinner in several areas, exposing green hillsides, dark wooded slopes, scattered houses, and a clustered village in the valley. A larger gray-white cloud mass remains along the upper right hillside and sky area while smaller fog patches continue passing through the lower and middle portions of the view.

reasons: Dense pale fog covers most of the landscape.
Only a dark distant ridge shape is faintly visible.
Foreground and valley details are mostly obscured.

evidence_bank.observation: Dense pale fog covers most of the lower and middle frame.

A distant dark ridge is faintly visible through the fog on the left.
Green hillside patches appear through openings in the fog.
Small light-colored buildings become visible in the valley.
Several fog patches have separated into distinct soft-edged masses.
Fog patches in the lower frame change position and outline between frames.
A broad gray-white cloud bank remains along the upper right portion of the view.
The clustered village is clearly visible near the center-right valley.
Layered blue-green ridges are visible across the background.
Only smaller fog remnants remain near the lower frame and side areas.
The camera viewpoint remains fixed on the same valley composition.
